items.title: Earlier history loads automatically at the thread top
items.precondition: An isolated runtime is available and the selected conversation has more than one history page.
steps: Open the conversation at its newest messages.
Confirm no Load earlier messages button is visible.
Scroll to the top of the message pane.
Wait for the next historical page, then repeat until no more history remains.
items.expected: Each older page loads once automatically, messages remain chronological, and no manual load button appears.
items.evidence: 2026-08-06: user confirmed in the local app that older history loads at the top without the manual button.

items.title: Frontend quality gates
steps: Run npm run typecheck in frontend/.
Run npm run lint in frontend/.
Run npm run build in frontend/.
items.evidence: 2026-08-06: npm run typecheck, npm run lint, and npm run build each exited 0 in frontend/.
items.notes: Lint reported pre-existing warnings outside this change; Vite reported an existing bundle-size advisory.

items.title: Incoming bubbles stay compact and time gaps are labeled
items.precondition: An isolated runtime with consecutive messages that cross the grouping window, including a later reply from the other participant, plus at least one reaction.
steps: Open the conversation thread.
Compare consecutive incoming and outgoing vertical gaps.
Locate a time gap, including one where the sender changes.
Confirm the next message has a centered absolute timestamp and that it is readable on the pink theme.
Tap both incoming and outgoing bubbles, then confirm their revealed timestamps are readable.
Confirm a reaction retains visible clearance from the next message.
items.expected: Consecutive incoming bubbles match the compact outgoing gap; time gaps show a clearly readable absolute timestamp regardless of sender; reaction clearance remains visible.
items.evidence: 2026-08-06: user confirmed compact bubbles, sender-independent time-gap timestamps, and themed timestamp contrast in the local app.

items.title: Search-result context continues toward newer messages
items.precondition: An isolated runtime with a conversation longer than two pages and a searchable message that is not on the latest page.
steps: Search for and select the older message.
Confirm it is highlighted near the middle of the thread.
Scroll downward until the bottom context sentinel is reached.
Continue until the latest known message is visible, then scroll upward to confirm older loading still works.
items.expected: The selected result remains visible initially; newer pages load exactly once per bottom intersection until the latest message is reached; older pages remain available at the top; no duplicate or out-of-order messages appear.

items.title: Chat pane hides its visual scrollbar without losing scrolling
items.precondition: An isolated runtime with a conversation taller than its message pane.
steps: Open the conversation on desktop and mobile widths.
Confirm no scrollbar track or thumb appears at the right edge of the chat pane.
Scroll with the wheel or trackpad, touch, keyboard focus, and the existing top/bottom pagination flows.
items.expected: The scrollbar is hidden only in the chat pane; every supported scrolling and automatic pagination behavior continues to work.
